A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before we
begin.

Can I customize the size, color and branding?+

Your project can start with a preferred structure, dimensions, colors and artwork. Share your product measurements and design ideas so the final options can be reviewed together.

What is the minimum order quantity?+

Minimum quantities depend on the structure, materials, finish and production method. Include your expected quantity in the project brief so a suitable specification can be discussed.

Can I review a sample first?+

A physical prototype is an important part of a custom packaging project. Confirm sampling options, costs and timing with your packaging contact before approving production.

How long will my project take?+

Timing varies with design development, sampling, materials, order size and delivery destination. A project-specific schedule should be confirmed in your quotation.

What should I include in my inquiry?+

Tell us the product type, box dimensions, approximate order quantity, desired materials or finishes, delivery destination and target date. Reference artwork or a description of your brand will also help.
